prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Learn quick hotkeys and desktop controls to interact with, hide, or summon your desktop pet.", "Press Alt+P to summon or hide pet", "Got It!"]
1: ["Create & Preview Your Custom Pet", "Upload photos with clear lighting so your 3D desktop pet renders accurately."]
2: []
3: ["Preparing Desktop Engine & Overlay Permissions", "We are configuring your pet's desktop window. Please ensure desktop permissions are granted.", "Verifying GPU overlay support"]
4: ["Choose Your Pet Path & Unlock Free Starter Gear", "Select a ready companion or build your own to claim an exclusive launch collar!", "Includes Free Gold Collar"]
5: ["You can switch windows! We will play a notification sound when your pet is ready on your desktop."]
6: ["Your unique Adoption Certificate ID is automatically saved to your account profile to prevent pet resets.", "Cloud Backup Enabled"]
7: ["Welcome Home! Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is active on your desktop screen. Check the quick guide on the right to start interacting.", "Quick Tips"]
8: ["Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to open the menu or hide them while working."]
9: ["Bring Your Screen to Life in 2 Minutes", "Pick a pre-made pet or customize your companion from photos. Your pet lives on your desktop overlay.", "Start Setup"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and exclusive gifts
